claims.claim: FineWeb is a 15-trillion-token dataset derived from 96 Common Crawl snapshots.
claims.notes: Dataset scale and snapshot count are claims made by the paper; do not generalize to other corpora.

claims.claim: FineWeb-Edu is a 1.3-trillion-token educational subset filtered using a custom classifier.
claims.notes: The paper describes synthetic annotations from Llama-3-70B-Instruct and a trained linear regressor.

claims.claim: CCNet combines language identification, deduplication and filtering toward high-quality reference corpora such as Wikipedia.
claims.notes: Do not claim that this was the first language-identification pipeline or that one filter is universally optimal.

claims.claim: Dolma is a three-trillion-token English corpus built from web content, scientific papers, code, public-domain books, social media and encyclopedic materials.
claims.notes: Keep token count distinct from storage bytes.

claims.claim: FineWeb data ablations hold model configuration and sampled token budgets constant across compared data variants and use two seeds per variant.
claims.notes: This supports the lesson about controlled ablations; it is not a guarantee that all confounders are eliminated.
